Printers.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive Android UI automation page object for HP Smart app printer management. It extends SmartFlow and provides extensive functionality for printer discovery, connection, and setup across different Android versions (7-12+). Key patterns include: 1) Platform-specific handling using version checks (Android 9 vs 10+), 2) Robust error handling with try-except blocks and retry logic, 3) Extensive use of wait strategies and timeouts for asynchronous operations, 4) Support for multiple printer connection types (WiFi, WiFi Direct, Ethernet, OOBE), 5) Permission handling for location and bluetooth services, 6) Scrolling and searching capabilities for printer lists, 7) Comprehensive verification methods for all screens and popups, 8) Conditional flows based on parameters like is_permission, is_network, wifi_direct flags. The class handles complex flows like OOBE printer setup, AWC (Automatic Wireless Connect), remote printer selection, and WiFi Direct authentication. Notable implementation details include StaleElementReferenceException handling, offset-based clicking for embedded links, and dynamic element construction using format specifiers.
